title: The Curse of Ramses II
description: An ancient royal seal drags the player into nine escalating curses. Endure the cost, complete the rituals, trigger reversals, and walk toward the end between dynastic judgment and the ashes of the underworld.
body:
The Curse of Ramses II is a Forge mod built around nine progressive curses, reversal rituals, dynastic lore, and survival pressure.
Once the Seal of Kadesh is equipped, the player becomes bound to a sequence of escalating curses.These curses affect combat, experience, trading, inventory control, hunger, death, and more. They are not isolated debuffs, but part of a connected progression system that unfolds over time.The mod is not only about punishment, but about finding ways to reverse what has been imposed on you.Through rituals, choices, riddles, item collection, and special events, the player can gradually transform curses into new states. Some reversals grant power, some remove long-standing burdens, and some decisions permanently define the path forward.

The mod includes:
- A full nine-curse progression system
- Unique reversal events and conditions
- Guilt, Mercy, and Satiety Debt mechanics
- Dream-choice events and death inversion
- Ember of Duat related ritual progression
- A full in-game Patchouli manual
- Survival-focused design suitable for longer playthroughs and modpacks

If you enjoy oppressive survival systems, ritual-driven progression, gradual unlocks, and a dramatic mythic tone, this mod is built for that kind of experience.

Feature List
- Nine-stage curse progression
- Unique reversal conditions for different curses
- Guilt / Mercy / Satiety Debt HUD systems
- Death inversion and high-risk, high-reward mechanics
- Lore, rituals, riddles, and guidebook content
- Designed for long-form survival and modpack play
- Built for Minecraft 1.20.1 Forge
